{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print(sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check the unique values in revenue
distinct_revenue = sales['revenue'].unique()
print(f"Unique revenue values: {distinct_revenue}")

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check the distribution of channels and segments
print("\nChannel distribution:\n", sales['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:\n", sales['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
